title: Mexico, Aztec, Spanish and Republican, Vol. 1 of 2 A Historical, Geographical, Political, Statistical and Social Account of That Country From the Period of the Invasion by the Spaniards to the Present Time.
summary: "Mexico, Aztec, Spanish and Republican, Vol. 1 of 2" by Brantz Mayer is a historical account written in the mid-19th century. As Cortéz prepares his expedition, the text introduces his character and ambitions while also hinting at tensions with Velasquez, his former patron.
